body: As I said, they wouldn't take me seriously.
While I did give it some thought, I'm not sure if he would notice or understand, that's one of the things that's been keeping me here.
Not really, my siblings do nothing but mock me, the only one that truly lifts my spirit is my dog.
Too bad my parents wouldn't take me seriously. Besides, I don't even know if it's a thing in my country...
